title: The Quiet Terminal
author: Ansel Eastwick
blurb: Freya Vasquez, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
